feedback: APPROVE. PRD is appropriately scoped for a trivial single-line README append: scope strictly limited (FR-7, NG1-NG5), acceptance tests are behavioral and human-verifiable (wc -l, diff, grep, git status --porcelain) with no brittle byte/hex contracts, and pre-state in TC-2 matches the actual README. One minor non-blocking tension: AT-1 ('exactly one greater') vs OQ-1 (optional blank separator would make delta two) — documented as an open question, acceptable.

findings.message: AT-1 asserts line-count delta of exactly one, but OQ-1 leaves an optional blank separator line open; if the implementer chooses the blank-line option, AT-1 would fail. Consider clarifying AT-1 to allow delta of 1 or 2, or resolving OQ-1 before spec.
OQ-1 (blank-line separator) and OQ-2 (exact wording) should be resolved before the spec phase to avoid ambiguity in acceptance verification.
